RecordThing.Description: A three-axle trailer for the Rover (Cargo). Wrench its drawbar near the rover's rear hitch to couple it. The deck has six bays, each carrying one crate or two portable tanks.
A three-axle habitat trailer for the Rover (Cargo): a walk-in field base. Wrench its drawbar near the rover's rear hitch to couple it.
Place it to start a Trailer (Cargo) frame. Build the frame up with a welder and 10 steel sheets, then a wrench and 10 plastic sheets.
A Trailer (Cargo) being built. Welder and 10 steel sheets for the deck and pods, then a wrench and 10 plastic sheets to finish it.
Place it to start a Trailer (Habitat) frame. Build it up with a welder and 20 steel sheets, a wrench and 20 plastic sheets, then a wrench and 8 electronic parts.
A Trailer (Habitat) being built. Welder and 20 steel sheets for the floor and wall frame, a wrench and 20 plastic sheets for the shell, a wrench and 8 electronic parts to finish it.
Place it to start a Rover (Cargo) frame. Build it up with a welder and 10 steel sheets, then 10 plastic sheets in one hand and 4 electronic parts in the other.
A Rover (Cargo) being built. Welder and 10 steel sheets for the hull, then 10 plastic sheets and 4 electronic parts to finish it.
